verdict.rationale: Devin's Outposts feature lets you run Devin sessions on infrastructure you control, such as your own VMs, containers, Kubernetes clusters or a Mac Mini. That is a documented first-party self-hosting capability for session execution. The evidence does not show that the full core product (control plane, models, orchestration) can be self-hosted, and the local CLI is described as having "deep Devin Cloud integration". missing for 10: evidence that the control plane and backend can be fully self-hosted without Devin Cloud, deployment/installation docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Outposts lets you run Devin sessions inside infrastructure you control — your own VMs, containers, Kubernetes clusters, or even a Mac Mini on your desk.
Devin CLI, a local command-line coding agent with deep Devin Cloud integration.
